char_01.name: Eldrin Vane
char_01.summary: A gaunt sellsword hunting his sister's murderer. Secretly responsible for her death. Cannot trust authority figures.

char_02.name: Mira Thorn
char_02.summary: An elderly healer who runs Thorn's Hearth, the only fresh water settlement in the Marches. Opposes the Salt Priests.

char_03.name: High Priest Malachar
char_03.summary: Leader of the Salt Priests. Wears a salt-crusted mask. Seeks to resurrect the dead god. Was once a healer who lost everything.

fac_01.name: The Salt Priests
fac_01.summary: A cult that worships a dead god buried beneath the salt flats. Publicly harmless monks, secretly ruthless relic hunters.

art_01.name: The God-Heart Shard
art_01.summary: A black crystal from a dead god's heart. Can kill anything mortal at the cost of aging the wielder. Causes nightmares.

cre_01.name: Salt Wraith
cre_01.summary: An undead creature formed from salt-storms. Hunts by sound. Pure water dissolves it.

evt_01.name: The Godfall
evt_01.summary: Three thousand years ago, a god of salt and silence fell from the heavens. Its corpse cursed the land and broke linear time.

magic.name: Magic System
magic.summary: Powered by consuming salt infused with divine blood. Always has a physical cost. Fails near running water.

loc_02.name: The Salt Temple
loc_02.summary: A cathedral carved from compressed salt, glowing from within. Headquarters of the Salt Priests. Contains a map to the God-Heart.

loc_03.name: Thorn's Hearth
loc_03.summary: A settlement built around a natural spring — the only fresh water for miles. Protected by the Spring Wardens.
